gaps: Physical hardware testing (checkpoint 9) cannot be fully automated in CI — requires TestFlight on real devices with actual LED controllers
Bluetooth background execution reliability over hours/days requires long-running manual/device-farm testing
Siri intent recognition accuracy with natural language variations not testable in simulator — needs real device validation
Widget timeline refresh interval behavior (system-controlled) cannot be precisely timed in tests
Watch complications update budget (system-enforced) not verifiable in simulator
LEDCommandEncoder protocol refinement depends on reverse-engineering real hardware — placeholder tests only validate structure
Background task scheduling exact timing (15 min) is approximate; iOS coalesces tasks — test uses accelerated simulator trigger
